I’d like to request a fox girl illustration!

Hello! I'm excited to finally get to commission you!

I would like art of my character Megrez: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1laeHwPo2iQl4Dv4CzzD54E7u-pQiG3_G/view?usp=drivesdk

She's a magical girl who has been on a long journey of atonement and self-improvement after a traumatic conflict. As a result, she often looks a bit serious or glum, but recently she has been trying to smile more and be happier.

Her powers are themed around eggs, and because Easter decorations have started popping up by me, I thought it would be cute if her magic eggs suddenly became more colorful like you'd expect from "Easter eggs." It's hard to be so serious when faced with that kind of color! If possible, I'd like her to be drawn with colorful eggs.

You can draw her in either outfit on the reference, and I leave the rest of the details up to you. I look forward to seeing what you do!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1laeHwPo2iQl4Dv4CzzD54E7u-pQiG3_G/view?usp=drivesdk
